description: Make a designed infographic of a topic: the AI picks the shape that fits (steps, cycle, timeline, roadmap, funnel, pyramid, hub, tree, comparison, 2×2 matrix or architecture layers), icons and colours, and fills in what a complete picture needs. Use it when the user wants an infographic, a visual, a one-page graphic or a slide graphic of a process, plan, architecture, comparison, timeline or concept, rather than a box-and-arrow diagram. Pass a description of the topic, or the link of a diagram made earlier in this chat to turn that diagram into a visual. Returns a link that opens it in AI Flowchart's Visual view (change the shape, look and colours, edit any part, export PNG/SVG) and a PNG image. Uses 1 AI credit.

description.description: The topic in detail: the stages, parts, options or events to show, with names and specifics from the conversation. Leave out only when diagram is given.

diagram.description: Optional: link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, mind map, sequence, swimlane, BPMN, system design or ER diagram made earlier, to draw as a visual.

name: create_visual
title: Create a visual (infographic)
